name: Pócsmegyer (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pócsmegyer: a blue and green shield with a sun, crossed tools and a wheel, within a yellow frame inscribed POCSMEGYER and SURÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pócsmegyer arms in a yellow frame
